author: Armeniangel
quote: A spectacular game. Thrilling from beginning to end, whether you’ve played the previous installment or not. A gripping story, compelling characters, and one of the best soundtracks ever—or perhaps the best. What a game!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Armeniangel
